description: Senior reviewer finds thread safety issue and provides good direction. Solid senior performance.

prContext.title: Add worker thread pool
prContext.description: Manages a pool of worker threads for CPU-intensive scoring.
prContext.instructions: Review for concurrency and resource management.

groundTruth.description: Worker path is relative ./scorer.js — in bundled or distributed code, the worker script path may not resolve. Should use __dirname or workerData for path resolution.
Message handler is shared across all tasks — if a worker completes a task after a timeout, the wrong promise may be resolved. Need task ID correlation.
No worker error handling — if a worker crashes, the pool loses a worker permanently and queued tasks stall. Should respawn crashed workers.
No backpressure or queue limit — unbounded queue can grow until OOM under load. Should limit queue size and reject or shed load.

reviewer_comments.what: Worker path may not resolve in production builds.
reviewer_comments.why: Relative paths break with bundlers and monorepos. Use __dirname or resolve path at runtime.

reviewer_comments.what: Message handler does not correlate responses with tasks.
reviewer_comments.why: Without task IDs, the wrong promise could be resolved on concurrent tasks.

reviewer_comments.what: Unbounded queue can OOM under load.
reviewer_comments.why: Need a max queue size with backpressure.

rounds.reviewer_summary: Three blocking issues: path, correlation, and backpressure.

implementer_responses.updated_code: worker.postMessage({ taskId: ++this.taskId, task: item.task }); ... worker.on('message', ({ taskId, result }) => { const item = this.pending.get(taskId); ... });
if (this.queue.length >= this.maxQueue) return Promise.reject(new Error('Queue full')); ... this.maxQueue = size * 10;

verdict.summary: All three fixes verified. Path resolution, task correlation, and backpressure look correct.

issue_identification.rationale: Found 3 of 4 bugs (path, correlation, queue). Missed worker respawn. Level 3-4.

prioritization.rationale: All three flagged as blocking. Good triage. Level 3-4.

revision_evaluation.rationale: Verified all three fixes. Path and task ID changes are correct. Level 3-4.

reasoning_quality.rationale: Concrete concurrency and deployment rationales. Level 3-4.

ai_direction.rationale: Suggested __dirname, task IDs, queue limit — all actionable. Level 3-4.
